name: Armed with Proof + Senator Peacock — an unattached Clue gives no creature +2/+0
notes: Reported 2026-11-23. _attachedSourceHasAbility compared each effect's targetId with state.id, but board states carry no id, so every untargeted effect (targetId undefined) of an artifact made a Clue Equipment counted as an attachment: Grizzly Bears got +2/+0 with nothing attached. The state's id is now read from allStates, and an Equipment attached through Equip is left to its own tracker (else +4/+0).
